title: Brown Long-Sleeve Top & Cargo Parachute Pants
prompt: An original young woman with long, curly honey-blonde hair walks through a bright indoor corridor carrying a large black leather duffel bag. She wears a fitted black long-sleeve scoop-neck top that stops above the waist, layered with two thin silver necklaces. Taupe ruched parachute cargo trousers with drawstrings and a low waistband complete the look. Her expression is calm and serious. Soft, cool interior light with a blurred figure behind her. Palette of chocolate, taupe, and black. Nostalgic and utilitarian, in the style of a late-1990s film still.
workingNotes:
- The curly hair and parachute trousers are the signature elements.
- Keep the blurred background for a candid, on-the-move feel.
